capabilities.name: Controlled date simulation
capabilities.description: Runs Python clock probes and fixture programs under faketime in a Celesto cloud sandbox.

capabilities.name: Candidate-date investigation
capabilities.description: Combines predefined boundary dates with LLM-suggested dates, tests outcomes, and records the observed date statuses.

capabilities.name: Repeated fixture execution
capabilities.description: Repeats each date's fixture execution to identify consistent pass/fail outcomes and mixed results.

capabilities.name: Benchmark evidence and oracle scoring
capabilities.description: Records scenario results and compares verdict labels with the expected labels in the oracle.
